name: accordion

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the first answer fully open with its rotated chevron, and the rest of the list closed.

tagline: Rows of questions that push open to show their answer.
summary: A single column of collapsible question rows; clicking one rotates its chevron and slides the answer open while closing any other. The rest of the list stays compact.
appearance: Four dark rounded rows stacked with thin gaps on a near-black page, each with a left-aligned question and a chevron at its right. The open row is pale grey with a block of dark answer text beneath it; closed rows are darker with muted labels.
behaviour: Clicking a row expands its answer with a spring height and a clip reveal, and the chevron flips to point up. Only one row is open at a time, so opening another closes the previous; hovering brightens a closed row.
demo_content: Four questions about UI components, including What is a UI component? and How do components improve UX?
search_phrases: click a row to reveal the answer
one answer open at a time
use_when: You need a tidy FAQ or disclosure list where only one answer is relevant at a time.
avoid_when: Only one answer can stay open, so readers cannot compare several answers at once.
customise: Questions and answers are written into the JSX per item; multiple and defaultValue on the root control whether one or many can open. Colours come from the shared row classes.
weight_why: Four rows and one spring height animation driven by a motion library.

a11y.note: Headers are buttons with aria-expanded and labelled panels, but the spring motion ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: Closed question labels sit in mid-grey on dark rows, so they are low contrast until hovered.
polish_why: Clean rows and a smooth spring reveal; the muted closed labels are low contrast.
